players.product: retail colocation & interconnection (IBX data centers, Equinix Fabric) and xScale hyperscale data centers

quarterly_data.signal: CFO Olivier Leonetti on power delivery: 'This year, we deploy 40% more power than we anticipated at the start of the year' and 'In 2026, we deliver twice the power we delivered in 2025.' Forward pipeline: 'Deploy between now and the end of 2029, 1 gigawatt of power. After that, we will have 2 gigawatts of land and power available to us.' He attributed the accelerated build to smaller data centers in communities that know Equinix and to long-term relationships with its general contractor and power management players: 'When we place an order, we have certainty' and 'We have also placed long-term orders with those players.'
quarterly_data.figure: 2026 power deployed 40% above the start-of-year plan; 2026 power delivered twice 2025; 1 gigawatt to deploy by end of 2029, then 2 gigawatts of land and power available

quarterly_data.signal: CFO Olivier Leonetti on demand: demand is strong and Equinix is 'now pushing back on some level of demands to push a diverse set of customers being present on our platform'; enterprise, neocloud, cloud provider and large language model customers all want to join, driven by agentic AI. CFO view: 'We believe that in the next three years, AI agentic will be 50% of the AI demand. We think that AI agentic in the next three years will be 30%-40% of the data center activity.' On cycle risk: 'CapEx, hyperscaler, neocloud this year is 80% higher than the prior year, and we see no sign of demand slowing down or investment slowing down'; if a slowdown came, he said it is 'likely to be training versus inference', and Equinix could delay CapEx. Regionally the U.S. is growing a bit faster than the rest of the world, with demand strong in all three regions.
quarterly_data.figure: CFO view: agentic AI 50% of AI demand and 30%-40% of data center activity within three years; hyperscaler and neocloud capex this year 80% higher than the prior year

quarterly_data.signal: CFO Olivier Leonetti said inference orchestration 'will happen really more in our data centers', with all Equinix data centers increasing power density for edge compute offerings; measured per cabinet, 'the power deployed by a cabinet has increased like 60% in the recent past', and some Equinix sites already host the latest high-power racks.
quarterly_data.figure: power deployed per cabinet up about 60% in the recent past

quarterly_data.signal: CFO Olivier Leonetti on strategy: retail colocation is the focus ('The maximum return today for Equinix is to do what we know how to do best, which is retail, colo, small footprint, rich ecosystem'), while xScale stays in the portfolio but is 'starting to be a crowded portfolio'. M&A priorities are land and power on an opportunistic basis (atNorth was one) and tuck-in technology acquisitions to complement the interconnection offering. New interconnection offerings are expected to be priced higher than prior ones; Fabric One lets participants connect 'in seconds, when before it used to take about a month'. He said the raised growth outlook to 2029 is not due to the additional CapEx, which is a drag before it pays back as of 2029 (a site takes two years to build and three years to fill).
